import { Product } from "../domain/product";
import { createApp } from "./app-factory";

const catalogue = [
  new Product("p-widget", "Widget", 100),
  new Product("p-gadget", "Gadget", 50),
  new Product("p-gizmo", "Gizmo", 10),
];

const port = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000);
createApp(catalogue).listen(port, () => {

});
